players.product: trapped-ion quantum computers (Forte, Forte Enterprise) sold as systems and as cloud access, plus quantum networking, sensing and security products

quarterly_data.quarter: IonQ press release: IonQ Demonstrates World-First Quantum Memory-Enhanced (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IonQ demonstrated entanglement rates above 1,000 per second (1 kHz) between a trapped-ion qubit and a silicon-vacancy (SiV) solid-state quantum memory through a photonic interconnect - more than four times the previous trapped-ion record, per the company (a hardware demonstration reported in a technical paper); the approach also drives its work in DARPA's HARQ program on high-speed quantum interconnects. IonQ's memory and interconnect platform is ramping commercially: the first commercial sale, to the University of Maryland, was announced in April, and a second system sale, to SDT in South Korea, in September.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 1,000 entanglements per second (demonstration); two commercial memory / interconnect system sales
